messages:
Nora K: Following the postmortem, we need to assign owners for remediation tickets and set timelines. I sketched a RACI in the doc.

OpsBot: Created epic PM-7890 and linked notes (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-7890).

Diego M: I'll take the infra hardening task. I'll open PM-7891 (tcp connection pooling) and propose a 3-week timeline.

Priya R: I'll own the alert tuning item. PM-7892 -> will update thresholds and add a recovery runbook. Target EOD next Tue.

Ken Z: I'll pair with Diego on the infra changes for validation. Suggest we have Ken = R for validation, Diego = A for implementation.

Nora K: RACI looks good. For customer comms, product will be A. @Priya R please confirm you can do the runbook content.

Priya R: Confirmed. I'll also add a short checklist: triage steps, who to page, throttling knobs.

Diego M: Noting this matches a recurring pattern from Jan where a slow drain caused connection pileup. I'll add a historical analysis section in PM-7891.

Nora K: Can we schedule a 30-min handoff meeting? OpsBot: create?

OpsBot: Meeting created: pm-remediation-handoff (2026-04-06 16:00 PT). Invitees: Nora K, Diego M, Priya R, Ken Z.

Ken Z: I'll put together a short validation script and link it to PM-7891.

Priya R: I'll start the runbook draft today and PR to docs once review is done.

Diego M: I'll add estimated effort and blocker notes in the ticket. If any infra approvals are needed I'll flag them.

Nora K: Final checklist before we lock thread: PM-7891 owner=Diego M, PM-7892 owner=Priya R, validation owner=Ken Z, epic=PM-7890. Weekly check-ins until closed. Thanks.

Priya R: Thanks all — ping in the epic for updates.

Ken Z: Locking thread, continue in PM-7890.
